name: Hadadezer
overview: Hadadezer, also called Hadarezer, was the king of Zobah who was decisively defeated by King David as he sought to recover his border along the Euphrates River. David's victory included the capture of vast military resources such as chariots, horsemen, and foot soldiers, and he established garrisons in Syrian territories, bringing those regions under his dominion. The Lord's providential protection over David is evident as David not only subdued Hadadezer but also the Syrians who came to his aid, further securing Israel's borders and enriching Jerusalem with spoils of war.
